Webbed_Mycelial_Swimming_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of the fungal caverns, these ghostly appendages pulse with mycelial energy, granting swiftness and agility to any creature they attach to, allowing them to glide through water with supernatural grace and recover from wounds at an accelerated rate.

Slime_Mold_Liquid_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of the fungal realm, the Slime_Mold_Liquid_Fins are translucent, gelatinous appendages that pulse with bioluminescent light, granting their bearer unmatched agility and the ability to glide effortlessly through treacherous underwater terrains.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Rudders.description: The Hardened Shelf Fungus Rudders are thick, muscular fungal appendages that sprout from the creature's torso, resembling dark, leathery fins. These rudders not only propel the creature through water with surprising speed and grace but also serve as formidable defensive structures, their tough, chitin-like texture providing exceptional natural armor against aquatic threats.

Bioluminescent_Glow_Fins.description: Bristling with delicate fungal tendrils that emit a soft, pulsating glow, the bioluminescent glow fins serve not only as a mesmerizing navigational aid in the darkest underwater caverns but also as a mystical beacon to draw in unsuspecting prey or guide allies through the treacherous depths.

Toxic_Spore_Venting_Fins.description: Bristling with dark, fungal tendrils, the Toxic_Spore_Venting_Fins are a horrid appendage that churns out a poisonous cloud as it propels its host through murky waters, enhancing its endurance while sapping the will of those who dare to approach.

Parasitic_Cordyceps_Fins.description: Emerging from the host's back like dark, translucent wings, the parasitic cordyceps fins are eerie fungal growths that grant the creature an otherworldly agility and dexterity in water, allowing it to dart through currents with a deadly precision and lock onto targets with an unsettling accuracy.

Decaying_Rot_Wood_Fins.description: The Decaying_Rot_Wood_Fins are eerie, translucent appendages that pulse with an unsettling green glow, their surface riddled with fungal growths and tendrils that seem to sap the vitality of the water they move through, granting their bearer a fearsome resistance to poison and the ability to instill dread in their aquatic adversaries, though at the cost of their agility and a hint of their once-vital connection to the living world.

Vibrant_Amanita_Frilled_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of a dark, fungal realm, the Vibrant Amanita Frilled Fins are a mesmerizing yet dangerous appendage, their iridescent, bioluminescent hues pulsating with an otherworldly allure that not only grants the wielder a charisma boost but also empowers them with the unsettling ability to summon a toxic cloud that deters and sickens foes.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of the Underdark, these crystalline fungal fins are bioluminescent appendages that grant their bearer unparalleled agility in subterranean waters, enhancing both wisdom and natural armor while bestowing the abilities of darkvision and spell reflection.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Fins.description: The Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Fins are eerie, semi-translucent fungal appendages that pulse with an otherworldly glow, allowing the creature to glide silently through water and air alike with supernatural grace, while their spectral nature grants a keen ethereal sight and unparalleled stealth in dark, damp environments.
